game_concept: A rhythm puzzle set in Eldritch Ruins – Moonstone Terrace, a terrace of moonstone: the relic hunter must handle echo phantoms while practicing lists. Core idea – Comprehension Lab: Build new lists in one line with list comprehensions to transform ancient keys.
theme: Eldritch Ruins – Moonstone Terrace: a terrace of moonstone
core_gameplay_loop: In Moonstone Terrace, repeat each round: Build new lists in one line with list comprehensions to transform ancient keys. Each round poses one decision; a wrong answer breaks the streak. Then check the lab_output value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Chain 9 consecutive correct decisions about lab_output to power up the relic hunter and open the heart stone.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: lives reach 0 (each wrong decision costs a life and resets the streak).
learning_alignment: Week 7 – Lists | Level 5 (applied tier): Comprehension Lab
assets_style: mysterious pixel-art ruins: mossy stone pillars, overgrown arches, faint eldritch glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Comprehension Lab' (Week 7 slot 11), mission type 'Streak Challenge', and setting 'Moonstone Terrace'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Eldritch Ruins
region.mood: eerie choir pads and stone-scrape stings

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how lab_output changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against echo phantoms in Moonstone Terrace.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: streak counter reaches 9.
